blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self-supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. The pretrained flow never moves the manipulated object; retraining it with latent-only losses only trades stillness for teleport-like motion. We trace the failure to the training signal, not the representation: anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision never says where along the horizon change belongs. Decode-augmented rollout training (DART) repairs this while keeping the representation frozen, retraining only the flow with decode-path supervision. DART outperforms its latent-only parent on the full protocol, restores the temporal structure of motion, and re-couples predicted motion to the scene; at larger scale it further improves prediction quality, closing nearly half the remaining gap to an oracle-informed interpolation reference. Finally, we report an unexpected finding about evaluation: pixel error alone rewards frozen predictions.
blocks.zh: 后期世界模型将流动整合在冰冻的自我监督的潜伏空间列车中,但静悄悄地失去地产操纵,这主要取决于:运动. 预先调节的流从不移动被操纵的物体;再培训它时只使用潜在的损失,只用静态来换取电传port般的运动. 我们追踪失败到训练信号,而不是代表:锚-sparse,潜伏-唯一监督从来不说沿地平线的变化属于何处。 解码助推培训(DART)在保持代表冻结的同时进行修复,仅对流进行解码路径监督的再培训. DART在全协议上超越了它潜在唯一的母体,恢复了运动的时间结构,并重新将预测的运动与现场连接起来;在更大的规模上,它进一步提高了预测质量,将剩下的近一半的缺口关闭到一个神谕知情的插图参考. 最后,我们报告一个关于评价的意外发现:光是像素错误就可以奖励冻结的预测.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Latent world models predict future observations by learning dynamics in a compact representation space instead of pixel space [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/Mangkhut160/icassp2027 . Trained checkpoint: https://huggingface.co/pzr114514/DART-PT-Flow-LIBERO . One influential design freezes a self-supervised encoder entirely and learns only a flow that integrates the latent over time; ODEWorld [ 1 ] instantiates this on LIBERO [ 3 ] with a DINOv2 [ 2 ] reconstruction autoencoder (RAE). Freezing stabilizes training and shrinks the trainable surface—but removes every pathway through which training can be forced to preserve what matters.
blocks.zh: 后期世界模型通过在紧凑的表示空间而不是像素空间中学习动态来预测未来的观测[5,6,7]. 1 1 1 代码:https://github.com/Mangkhut160/icassp2027 。 。 。 训练有素的检查站:https://huggingface.co/pzr114514/DART-PT-Flow-LIBERO. 一个有影响力的设计完全冻结了一个自我监督的编码器,并且只学习一段流,将潜伏在一段时间内融合起来;ODEWorld[1]在LIBERO[3]上用一个DINOv2[2]重建自动编码器(RAE)将这个瞬间化. 冰冻稳定了训练,缩小了可训练的表面——但消除了一切可能被迫训练以保全重要事物的路径。

blocks.en: On this system we document a silent degradation, invisible to standard losses yet obvious to any observer: motion collapse (Fig. 1 ). Open-loop rollouts leave the scene essentially static, teleport the object in a few steps, and lose the manipulator arm for most of the horizon—the model has, in effect, unlearned that scenes move at all.
blocks.zh: 在这个系统中,我们记录了一种无声的退化,对标准损失来说是看不见的,但对任何观察者来说是显而易见的:运动崩溃(图1)。 开放的展开让场景基本上静止, 传送物体几步,

blocks.en: We diagnose the failure to its root cause and repair it with the smallest possible intervention—the representation stays frozen throughout (Fig. 3 ). We first rule out the natural suspect, a train/inference time-scale mismatch: conditioning rollouts on more intermediate goals degrades monotonically. The actual cause is that supervision is both anchor-sparse and latent-only: about five anchors per 275-frame demonstration, all graded in latent space alone, leave the flow free to park motion anywhere along the horizon. Our repair, decode-augmented rollout training (DART), keeps the sampling schedule and instead changes what the supervision is graded in, extending the objective to decoded frames and region-level DINOv2 features so the gradient reaches the flow in the space the viewer sees. We then place the repaired system on an absolute scale, and show that the most natural evaluation metric—pixel error—systematically rewards the failure we set out to fix.
blocks.zh: 我们诊断其根本原因的失败,并尽可能采取最小的干预措施加以补救——其代表性始终处于冻结状态(图3)。 我们首先排除了天生的疑犯,一种列车/推算时间尺度的错配:在更中间目标上调节推出会单调降解. 实际原因是,监督既包括锚地,也包括潜伏:每275帧演示约5个锚地,它们都单独在潜伏空间中分级,使流动畅通无阻,可以在地平线沿线任何地方停车。 我们的修复,解码的推出训练(DART),保留了取样时间表,而是改变监督分级的内容,扩展了解码帧和地区级DINov2特性的目标,从而梯度到达了观众看到的空间中的流量. 然后,我们将修复的系统置于绝对规模上,并表明最自然的评价度量-像素误差-系统地奖励了我们规定的修复失败。

blocks.en: Our contributions: • A quantified diagnosis of motion collapse in frozen latent-flow designs: open-loop rollouts freeze the scene and teleport the object, with teleport statistics, template tracking, and a motion-concentration metric localizing the cause to anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision. • DART, which retrains only the flow with decode-path supervision, outperforming its latent-only parent on the full protocol, restoring motion structure with one fixed weighting across six runs, and re-coupling predicted motion to the scene (Sec. 5 ). • External reference points that fix the system’s absolute level—the original paper’s reported external world models, an oracle-informed interpolation floor, a trained video predictor in our harness, and the frozen-decoder upper bound—at which retraining closes 37 % 37\% of the interpolation gap and DART 47 % 47\% (Sec. 5.4 ). • An unexpected finding about how these models are evaluated: pixel L1 rewards stillness . The pixel loss is minimized by the near-static conditional mean of an uncertain future, so a flow that moves less scores better while erasing the motion it exists to predict—the variant in our family with the lowest L1 is also the most static one, and would have been selected as best by L1 alone.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: World models differ in where their dynamics live: latent imagination drives control in Dreamer and DreamerV3 [ 5 , 6 ] , DIAMOND [ 7 ] shows how much pixel-space detail matters in Atari, and generative world models at scale [ 8 , 9 ] renew the architecture debate; video metrics such as FVD [ 10 ] and multi-dimensional suites [ 11 ] grade the predictions such models produce. A long-standing pathology shadows all of them: pixel-trained predictors regress to the blurry conditional mean [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] , a bias we show reappears at the level of rollout dynamics . On LIBERO specifically, recent video world models [ 15 ] find pixel metrics and action relevance largely orthogonal—independent support for our claim that pixel error cannot be the sole referee. We take the ODEWorld system as given and complement architecture work with failure analysis, a minimal repair, and motion-aware evaluation.
blocks.zh: 世界模型在动态存在的地方不同:潜伏的想象力驱动着Dreamer和DreamerV3中的控制 [5,6],DIAMOND [7]显示阿塔里有多少像素-空间细节的重要性,以及规模[8,9]的基因世界模型更新架构辩论;像FVD[10]和多维套件[11]这样的模型的预测分级. 一个长期存在的病理阴影 这一切:像素训练的预测器 倒退到模糊的条件 平均值 [12, 13, 14], 我们显示的偏差 重新出现 在推出动态的水平。 在LiBERO上,最近的视频世界模型[15] 发现像素的度量和动作的相关性基本上为正统性——独立支持我们关于像素错误不能是唯一裁判的说法. 我们视ODEWorld系统为定型系统,并以故障分析、最低限度的修复和运动意识评价来补充建筑工作。

blocks.en: 3.2 Motion collapse
blocks.zh: 3.2 运动崩溃

blocks.en: This asymmetry shows up directly in the rollouts. Template tracking of the target object across open-loop rollouts (Fig. 2 ) separates three behaviors. Ground truth moves the object smoothly. The pretrained flow never moves the object at all . Retraining that flow with latent-only losses moves it but teleports: 68 % 68\% of tracked displacement lands in three steps, the manipulator stays absent until the τ = 1 \tau{=}1 goal conditioning takes over, and a single step carries the object 36 36 px.

blocks.en: We quantify the shape of motion with two complementary statistics, both reported throughout. The tracked-displacement concentration is the share of the object’s displacement inside its three largest steps—intuitive, but needing a per-object tracker. The frame-level motion concentration conc 3 = ( ∑ t ∈ 𝒯 3 Δ ¯ t ) / ∑ t Δ ¯ t \mathrm{conc}_{3}=\big(\sum_{t\in\mathcal{T}_{3}}\bar{\Delta}_{t}\big)/\sum_{t}\bar{\Delta}_{t} is the share of total frame-to-frame change Δ ¯ t = mean ​ | x t + 1 − x t | \bar{\Delta}_{t}=\mathrm{mean}|x_{t+1}-x_{t}| captured by the three largest steps; this one needs no tracker and is computable on every frame.

Before adopting the sparsity explanation, we rule out the natural suspect, a train/inference time-scale mismatch: conditioning rollouts on S S evenly spaced intermediate goals should help if scale were the cause, but error instead grows monotonically with S S (L1 11.08 → 47.60 11.08{\to}47.60 for S = 1 → 64 S{=}1{\to}64 ; 41 demonstrations), because near-goal conditioning is out of distribution for a flow trained on whole-demo spans. The cause is anchor sparsity combined with latent-only losses: nothing tells the flow where along the horizon change must happen.

blocks.en: 4 DART: Decode-Augmented Rollout Training
blocks.zh: 4 DART:解码强化推出培训

blocks.en: Figure 3: Image-goal DART: frozen DINOv2 and RAE surround trainable PT-Flow modules; dashed paths connect predictions to losses. The window is illustrative and uses a validation demonstration that did not take part in training.
blocks.zh: 图3:图像-目标DART:冻结的DINOv2和RAE环绕可训练的PT-Flow模块;破碎路径连接预测与损失. 该窗口具有说明性,采用未参加培训的验证演示.

blocks.en: DART leaves the sampling schedule unchanged: the anchors keep the same positions and spacing, and only the space in which the supervision is applied changes. The loss adds two decode-pathway terms to the latent rollout objective, ℒ = ℒ lat + 0.5 ​ ℒ dec + 0.5 ​ ℒ reg , \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{lat}}+0.5\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dec}}+0.5\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{reg}}, (1) where ℒ lat \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{lat}} is the latent rollout error over the window, ℒ dec = mean ​ | d ⁡ ( z ^ t ) − x t | \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dec}}=\mathrm{mean}\,|d(\hat{z}_{t})-x_{t}| supervises decoded frames, and ℒ reg \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{reg}} matches frozen DINOv2 features of predicted and reference frames, pooled over four per-frame feature clusters. Encoder, decoder, and goal predictor stay frozen; only the flow trains, with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 2) for 26,000 steps. DART must therefore satisfy three criteria at once: lower full-protocol L1 than its parent, motion concentration at or below the target fixed before training, and ordinary rollouts no worse. The gain comes from where the loss lands. Both new terms decode before the error is computed, so a mismatch visible in the picture becomes a loss directly, and the gradient travels back to the flow along the decode path. The latent-only loss, by contrast, compares latent values alone and cannot tell whether the picture actually moved.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: All experiments are offline open-loop predictions on official LIBERO demonstrations: 64-step image-goal rollouts at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 . We use three evaluation protocols. The full protocol scores 100 demonstrations, with DART and latent-only runs matched by training seed. The hard-5 subset collects the five demonstrations with the highest parent error, selected once before any DART training and shared by every variant; it also serves as our stress test, since the parent errs most where the ground truth moves most. A 650-demonstration benchmark tests scale. Motion is graded by three statistics: per-step L1 catches wrong pixels, conc 3 \mathrm{conc}_{3} catches mistimed motion, and total motion catches missing motion. We also report the per-demonstration correlation between predicted and ground-truth motion.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是LIBERO官方演示的离线开放预测:64步图像-目标推出256×256×256}256. 我们使用三个评估协议。 完整协议评分为100个演示,其中DART和潜伏的运行配以训练种子. 硬-5子集收集了母错误最高的5个演示,在任何DART训练之前被选中过一次,并被每个变体共享;它也作为我们的压力测试,因为母错误最多的是地面真理移动最多的地方. 650-示范基准测试尺度。 运动分三级:每步L1捕获错像素,conc 3\mathrm{conc}_{3}捕获错时运动,总运动捕获错时运动. 我们还报告预测和地面真实运动之间的每一次证明关联。

blocks.zh: 表2:硬-5子集(GT conc 3 = 0.099\mathrm{conc}_{3}{=}0.099),每个变体的五个相同的演示;范围跨独立运行.

blocks.en: 5.2 Does DART restore motion?
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). DART恢复运动吗?

blocks.en: On the full protocol (Table 1 ), DART improves on its latent-only parent in mean and median L1 on both seeds. The improvement in motion structure is clearest on the first seed pair: concentration falls to 0.145 0.145 against ground truth 0.093 0.093 , total motion rises from 11 % 11\% to 29 % 29\% of ground truth, and the largest single-step change stays at ground-truth scale, so motion spreads across the horizon instead of forming new teleports. The second seed keeps the error gain with a smaller motion shift, within the hard-5 run-to-run spread. The two motion metrics capture different aspects of the rollout: DART largely fixes where motion happens but not how much . No term in the objective rewards the magnitude of change, so a persistent gap in magnitude is expected.
blocks.zh: 在完整的协议(表1)中,DART改进了两种种子的L1中值和L1中值中唯一潜在母体。 运动结构的改善在第一对种子中最为明显:浓度下降至0.1450.145,对地面真理0.0930.093,总运动由地面真理的11%11\%上升到29\%的29\%,最大的单步变化停留在地面真理尺度上,因此运动会横跨地平线,而不是形成新的电传port. 第二种子将误差增益保留在较小的运动转动中,在硬-5跑向跑的散射范围内. 两个运动度量法捕捉了推出过程的不同方面:DART基本上修正了运动发生的地方,但并没有修正多少. 目标中没有任何词语奖励变化的幅度,因此预期在幅度上会出现持久的差距。

blocks.en: On the hard-5 subset (Table 2 ), all six DART runs improve on both parent runs in L1, and the family-mean concentration drops from 0.342 0.342 to 0.228 0.228 , better than the stronger parent run in five of six runs. The runs share the same recipe and the same five demonstrations, so their spread comes only from optimization randomness. Doubling either loss weight barely changes the result (Table 2 ), so we keep both at 0.5 0.5 . The relation between motion and scene content is more telling. In the parent, per-demonstration total motion is uncorrelated with ground truth (Spearman − 0.07 -0.07 ), so how much it moves carries no information about what actually moves and is instead an artifact of the model; DART restores the relation (Pearson + 0.26 +0.26 ), and predicted motion is again driven by the scene rather than by the model itself.
blocks.zh: 在硬-5子集(表2)上,所有6个DART运行在双亲运行在L1中都有所改善,家庭-平均浓度从0.342 0.342降至0.228 0.228,优于6个运行中5个中较强的父母运行. 跑步共用相同的食谱和相同的五个演示,因此它们的传播只来自于优化随机性. 双倍的减重几乎不会改变结果(表2),所以我们两者都保持0.5。 动作和场景内容的关系更能说明问题. 在母体中,每个演示总运动与地面真理无关(Spearman – 0.07 - 0.07),因此它移动的多少没有包含实际移动的信息,而是模型的一件文物;DART恢复关系(Pearson + 0.26 + 0.26),预测的运动再次由场景而不是模型本身驱动.

blocks.en: 5.3 Does pixel L1 mislead?
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 像素L1有误导吗?

blocks.en: The part-decomposition variant gives the clearest warning. It replaces DART’s region loss, which pools DINOv2 features over four clusters computed within each frame, with a decomposition whose parts keep the same identity across frames; it also widens the window to 9 and optionally adds a loss on the direction in which parts displace. It reaches the lowest L1 of any variant we trained and the worst dynamics in the family (Fig. 4 ). The reason is that the future is uncertain: many next frames are plausible, and their average is blurry and nearly static, so L1 is minimized by predicting close to that average. A flow that moves less therefore scores better on L1 while destroying the motion it exists to predict. Pixel losses are known to induce this blur bias in video prediction [ 12 , 13 ] , and here it is visible across the entire rollout. Ranked by L1 alone, it would have been selected as the best in the family, which is why the concentration target was fixed before training.
blocks.zh: 分解变体给出最明确的警告. 它取代了DART的区域损失,将DINov2的特征集中到每个帧内计算出来的四个集群上,并进行分解,其部件在帧之间保持同样的特性;它还将窗口扩大至9个,并可以选择地增加部分取代方向的损失。 它达到了我们所训练的任何变种中最低的L1,也是家庭中最糟糕的动态(图4). 原因是未来是不确定的:许多下一个帧是可信的,它们的平均值是模糊的,几乎是静止的,因此L1通过接近该平均值的预测而最小化. 因此移动较少的流量在L1上得分较好,同时破坏它存在的预测运动. 已知像素损失会在视频预测中诱发这种模糊的偏差[12,13],在此可见整个推出过程. 单以L1排名,本会被选为全家最佳,因此集中目标在训练前就已经确定.

blocks.en: Figure 4: The stillness trap (hard-5): part-decomposition variants attain the lowest L1 but revert to teleport-like concentration; DART reaches the best dynamics at comparable L1.
blocks.zh: 图4:静态陷阱(硬-5):部分分解变体达到最低L1,但恢复到类似电传port的浓度;DART在可比L1达到最佳动态.

blocks.en: 5.4 How does the system compare in absolute terms?
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 系统如何以绝对值进行比较?

blocks.en: Table 3: Absolute reference points. Top: external models as reported in ODEWorld’s comparison (their protocol, 6,500 demos) [ 1 ] . Middle: our harness, 650-demo split; interpolation is oracle-informed, RAE is a decode upper bound, not predictors. Bottom: SimVP [ 16 ] , same split (two-seed ranges); LPIPS is Alex, rollout-averaged.
blocks.zh: 表3:绝对参考点。 顶级:ODEWorld比较中报告的外部模型(其协议,6,500个演示) [1]. 中间:我们的拉带,650-demo分裂;插值是oracle知情的,RAE是一个解码的上界,而不是预测器. 底部:SimVP [16],相同拆分(双种子范围);LPIPS为Alex,推出平均.

blocks.en: All comparisons so far have been internal, between DART and its own parent. We now place the system on an absolute scale against four references: two external world models reported by the original ODEWorld evaluation [ 1 ] , an oracle-informed interpolation and the frozen decoder’s reconstruction bound from our harness, and a trained video predictor (Table 3 ). The design we build on already led its published comparison, both external models trailing it there, and our improvements come on top: within our harness (PSNR and LPIPS [ 4 ] ), flow retraining closes 37 % 37\% of the distance between the pretrained flow ( 17.7 17.7 dB) and an oracle-informed linear interpolation ( 22.0 22.0 dB), and DART closes 47 % 47\% , about two decibels above the pretrained flow; the frozen decoder’s reconstruction bound ( 26.7 26.7 dB) localizes the remaining headroom in the latents the flow produces.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,所有比较都是内部的,在DART与自己的父母之间。 现在,我们把系统放在一个绝对的尺度上,而不是四个参照点:ODEWorld最初评价报告的两个外部世界模型、一个信条知情的插图和被冻结的解码器的重建,以及一个训练有素的视频预测器(表3)。 我们所基于的设计已经引导了它公布的比较, 外部模型都跟随它, 我们的改进来自顶端: 在我们的牵引力(PSNR和LPIPS[4])范围内, 流动再培训关闭了37%的37 %,

blocks.en: The most informative reference is SimVP [ 16 ] , a standard convolutional video predictor trained on the same split in our harness: it reaches 23.4 23.4 dB under start–goal–interpolation conditioning, matching ground-truth motion timing ( conc 3 \mathrm{conc}_{3} 0.095 0.095 vs. 0.101 0.101 ) and motion tracking the scene (Spearman 0.88 0.88 ). This exceeds our system: the task is learnable to a pixel level we do not attain, so the deficit is in the training signal, not the task. Could this match be leaked through the interpolated conditioning? A variant receiving only the two endpoints, with the rest zeroed, loses less than 0.3 0.3 dB and still reproduces both motion metrics: the match is learned, not leaked.
blocks.zh: 资料最丰富的参考文献是SimVP[16],这个标准演化的视频预测器在我们的绳索上经过同样的分解训练:它达到23.4 23.4 dB在起始-目标-内插条件下,匹配地面真实运动时间(conc 3\mathrm{conc}_{3} 0.095 0.095对0.101 0.101)和运动跟踪场景(Spearman 0.88 0.88). 这超越了我们的系统:任务可以学习到我们没有达到的像素水平,所以赤字在于训练信号,而不是任务. 这个火柴能通过内插调子泄露出来吗? 一个只接收两个端点的变体,其余的为零,损失小于0.3 0.3 dB,仍然复制两个运动度量:匹配是学习的,没有泄露.

blocks.en: 5.5 Does it hold at scale?
blocks.zh: 5.5 导弹 它有规模吗?

blocks.en: On 650 demonstrations (Fig. 5 ), latent-only retraining of the same flow cuts per-step L1 by ≈ 27 % {\approx}27\% , and DART improves again at this scale: with three seeds per family, every DART seed falls below every parent seed (mean L1 10.36 10.36 – 10.44 10.44 against 10.73 10.73 – 11.01 11.01 ). Gains are largest at the horizon’s end, where the anchor-sparsity diagnosis predicts, and hold across the five LIBERO suites. Scaling sharpens pixels but leaves the magnitude gap, so we tested the remedy directly: two variants add a motion-magnitude term, on decoded consecutive-frame differences or on latent displacement norms, inside the DART recipe at matched budget. Neither works. The latent variant leaves full-protocol mean L1 unchanged ( 9.88 9.88 vs. 9.94 9.94 ) while total motion falls to a third of DART’s and concentration worsens; the decoded variant damages concentration at a quarter of the budget. Rewarding magnitude thus pulls the flow toward stiller rollouts: the gap reflects the objective’s regression structure, not a missing loss term.
blocks.zh: 在650个示范(图5)中,潜在唯一的再培训,即每步L1减少同样流量的X% 27 % , 而DART在这一规模上再次有所改进:每个家庭有3个种子,每个DART种子都低于每个母种子(平均L1 10.36 – 10.44 10.44 – 10.73 10.73 – 11.01 11.01 ) 。 收益在地平线的尽头是最大的,其中锚角-斜度诊断预测,并占据了五个LIBERO套房。 缩放能磨亮像素,但留下尺寸差距,所以我们直接测试了补救方法:两个变体在DART配方内,在相应的预算上,在解码的连续框架差异或潜在迁移规范上,增加了一个运动放大词。 都没用 潜伏的变体使完全的变体平均L1不变(9.88 9.88对9.94 9.94),而总运动下降到DART的三分之一,浓度则恶化;解码的变体损害的浓度占预算的四分之一。 因此,回报的幅度拉动了流动向静态延伸:差距反映了目标的回归结构,而不是缺失的损失期。

blocks.en: Figure 5: 650-demo, 64-step open-loop benchmark: per-step mean L1 for the pretrained, latent-only, and DART flows (3 seeds each, ± \pm 1 std).
blocks.zh: 图5:650-demo,64步开放-loop基准:预训型,仅潜伏型,DART流的每步平均值L1(每步3个种子,±\pm 1 std).

blocks.en: 5.6 Failure analysis and future work
blocks.zh: 5.6 失败分析和今后的工作

blocks.en: Beyond the magnitude gap, the weakest link is the intermediate frames: decoded rollout frames saturate near 19 19 – 20 20 dB PSNR late in the horizon while the same decoder renders ground-truth latents at about 27 27 dB, so the deficit is in the produced latents. LPIPS objectives, region-level losses, velocity-magnitude proxies, longer budgets, and wider windows each fail to gain beyond about a percent, and a motion-magnitude reward (Sec. 5.5 ) lowers motion instead of raising it. Two causes are plausible: the regression to the mean behind the magnitude gap, and a bottleneck, since recognition-tuned DINOv2 latents may discard texture needed for frame sharpening. The matching remedies point to future work beyond the objective: blur-punishing decoders or encoder-side latent enrichment, plus motion-magnitude teachers such as optical-flow supervision.
blocks.zh: 除了体积差距之外,最薄弱的链接是中间帧:解码推出帧饱和度接近19 19 — — 20 个dB PSNR在地平线晚期,而同一解码器则使地平线潜伏在27 27 dB左右,因此赤字存在于产生的潜伏中. LPIPS 目标, 地区级的损失, 速度宽度的代理, 更长的预算, 以及宽度的窗口 都未能超过1%, 运动宽度的奖励( Sec. 5.5 ) 降低了运动而不是提高。 有两个原因是合理的:规模差距背后的正值回归,以及瓶颈,因为识别调整的DINOv2潜伏物可能会丢弃磨合框架所需的纹理。 匹配的补救方法指向目标以外的未来工作:模糊的解码器或编码器侧潜在浓缩,加上运动放大教师,如光流监督.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Frozen latent-flow world models can pass every training loss while forgetting how scenes move. The failure is diagnosable (anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision) and repairable without unfreezing the representation, and because pixel error rewards frozen predictions, motion-aware supplements are needed at evaluation.
blocks.zh: 冻结潜在流世界模型可以通过每一次训练损失,同时忘记场景如何移动. 故障是可诊断的(锁定-sparse,潜伏-仅监理),在不解冻表示的情况下可以修复,并且由于像素错误奖励冻结的预测,在评价时需要运动意识补充.
